references.text: Description of the same event where twelve baskets of leftovers were collected after five loaves were distributed to a large crowd.
Parallel account of collecting twelve baskets of bread leftovers after the miracle of the five loaves.
The immediately preceding verse where the disciples are instructed to gather the leftovers so that nothing is wasted.
The verse where the loaves were blessed and broken, leading to the twelve baskets of leftovers in the next verse.
The result of gathering the bread leftovers: the people recognize Jesus as the prophet who was to come.
